name: A_LOOKUP_OWNER
description: IP → responsible org (OU) + abuse contact. Input: ip. Fixture-first (embedded NREN CMDB table: SWITCH, ETH, UniBE NOC contacts), then a LIVE keyless RDAP lookup via rdap.org (IANA bootstrap → owning RIR) for any other IP — org from the registrant/network name, abuse email from the abuse-role entity. Unknown / offline / lookup-failure returns { known: false, ou: unknown, contact: null } rather than throwing.
